ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 3 — Focused Visit (Follow-up) — Zora Neale Hurston

code.originalText: Two-week review after dapagliflozin: metabolic panel, blood pressure and potassium, and benefits applications

text.paragraph: Ms. Hurston returns two weeks after starting dapagliflozin and atorvastatin. She is less breathless: she now climbs the stairs at the school without stopping, and her ankles no longer swell by evening. Her home blood pressure average this week is 134/82. She has had no lightheadedness, genital itching or burning on passing urine, and no muscle aches. She weighs herself each morning. Her SNAP benefits were approved, the patient assistance program shipped a 90-day supply of dapagliflozin, and the SHINE counselor helped her apply for Extra Help and the Medicare Savings Program. She can name the BE FAST signs and keeps the card by her telephone. [S]
